propositions: The gate check walks all ticket directories and reduces each one, costing O(ticket-count) metadata syscalls (~24,000 per write at 4,800+ tickets) and 486-502 ms on a quiet store, blowing the declared 20 ms budget by 25x on every write.

The gate runs on every write in every agent process, so its own latency creates positive feedback: K concurrent agents issuing writes means K simultaneous ~24,000-syscall walks that contend on kernel vnode cache, producing non-linear slowdown (10 walkers observed ~2.3s vs 486 ms single).
The budget-breach WARNING fires on 100% of writes once a store exceeds ~150 tickets, making it noise and invisible as an actual observability signal that should alert operators to soaked work.

The fix is an O(1) marker at .rebar/enrich-gate.json holding next_eligible_ns, returned immediately when provably quiet; pending_enrichment scans only if marker is absent/stale/invalid (self-healing), invalidated by every queue append.
